name: Methuen
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Methuen, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Methuen, MA: a drive-through light show at Mann Orchards, A Christmas Carol and a free open house at the Music Hall.
lede: Methuen does Christmas with a Santa Parade, a city tree lighting, a famous Festival of Trees and holiday music at Methuen Memorial Music Hall, plus a drive-through light show at Mann Orchards.
celebrates: The season in Methuen starts with the Santa Parade, run by a parade committee with the Parks and Recreation Department, where Santa rides a fire truck at the very end. The Methuen Festival of Trees fills its hall with decorated trees and wreaths, a children's scavenger hunt and visits with Santa, and the money raised goes toward saving historic buildings. The city's Tree Lighting has offered live music, sleigh rides, pony rides, train rides, photos with Santa and food trucks. Methuen Memorial Music Hall adds holiday concerts and a young people's theatre show, and Mann Orchards hosts a drive-through light show by Fiesta Shows.
lastyear: In 2025 the Methuen Santa Parade stepped off on Saturday, November 22, at 1 pm. The committee asked every group to follow a holiday or winter theme, banned candy throwing from moving vehicles and kept one rule firm: the only Santa allowed was the one on the fire truck at the end. The city later called it one of its biggest and best parades yet. Mayor Beauregard then invited families to the annual Tree Lighting on Sunday, December 7, from 5 to 8 pm at The Loop on Pleasant Valley Street.
facts: The Methuen Festival of Trees started small. In 1994 volunteers trying to save the 1830s Tenney Gate House set up 17 decorated trees at the Nevins Memorial Library and raised $3,100. The second year had 42 trees, the gate house was saved, and today it is home to the Methuen Museum of History. The festival has since shown up to 240 trees and wreaths, drawn as many as 30,000 guests and put more than $2 million into historic preservation.
trains: Methuen has no Commuter Rail stop of its own, but the MBTA Haverhill Line runs right past it, from North Station in Boston through Reading, Andover and Lawrence to Bradford and Haverhill. The city's own tree lighting has included train rides for kids. For a real train day, Lowell has the Boston and Maine Railroad Historical Society's steam locomotive No. 410 and the National Streetcar Museum, and Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express train through acres of Christmas lights.

Holiday music at the Music Hall
Methuen Memorial Music Hall, built by Edward F. Searles to house the Great Organ, fills December with concerts and shows.
Fiesta Shows turns the farm roads at Mann Orchards Riverside Farm into a drive-through tunnel of lights.
kidfact: The giant organ inside Methuen Memorial Music Hall was built back in 1863 for a concert hall in Boston, and a man named Edward Searles built a whole building in Methuen just to give it a new home.
faq: When is the Methuen Santa Parade?

In recent years the Methuen Santa Parade has come on the Saturday before Thanksgiving. In 2025 it stepped off at 1 pm on November 22, organized by the Santa Parade Committee with Parks and Recreation. Santa rides on the fire truck at the very end of the parade, and the city asks marchers not to throw candy from moving vehicles.
Where is the Methuen tree lighting?

The city has held its Tree Lighting at The Loop, 90 Pleasant Valley Street. In 2025 Mayor Beauregard invited families there on Sunday, December 7, from 5 to 8 pm. Past city listings promised live music, sleigh rides, pony rides, train rides, photos with Santa and food trucks. Check the city and Parks and Recreation pages for the current location.
What is the Methuen Festival of Trees?

It is a holiday fundraiser that began in 1994 at the Nevins Memorial Library with 17 trees. It now shows hundreds of decorated trees, mini trees and wreaths, with raffles, a gift shop, a children's scavenger hunt and Santa. The money goes to historic preservation projects across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine.
Is there a drive-through Christmas light show in Methuen?

Yes. Fiesta Shows runs the Merrimack Valley Celebration of Lights at Mann Orchards Riverside Farm on Merrimack Street on select nights in late November and December. Families stay in their cars along more than a mile of road, and tickets are sold per vehicle, cheaper online than at the gate.
Which train station is closest to Methuen?

Methuen has no Commuter Rail stop of its own. The nearest stations are Lawrence and Andover on the MBTA Haverhill Line, which runs south through Reading and Malden Center to North Station in Boston and north through Bradford to Haverhill. A train ride into the city can be part of a holiday day out.
